There were 570 subjects treated in this trial and 495 subjects included in the efficacy population (325 of whom received letemovir).
The efficacy of letemovir was demonstrated in a single Phase 3 trial, P001, in which 373 CMV seropositive allogeneic HSCT recipients received letemovir.

result.text: Clinically significant CMV infection through Week 24 occurred in 18% (57/325) of the letermovir arm vs 42% (71/170) of the placebo arm. The overall proportion who failed prophylaxis was 38% (letermovir) vs 61% (placebo), with a stratum-adjusted treatment difference of -23.5% (95% CI -32.5, -14.6; p<0.001).

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%, ≥2% over placebo): nausea (27% vs 23%), diarrhea (26% vs 24%), vomiting (19% vs 14%), peripheral edema (14% vs 9%), cough (14% vs 10%), headache (14% vs 9%), fatigue (13% vs 11%), abdominal pain (12% vs 9%). A higher cardiac adverse event rate was seen with PREVYMIS (13%) vs placebo (6%).
